name: Gronau (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Gronau (a yellow pale with a swan between figures on green).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Münster of 8 October 1981 the city of Gronau was granted the right to bear a flag and a banner in the city colours green and yellow striped 1:1.

features.role: Gronau arms — pale with swan on green
